material_deviations: An independently authored bounded tab-group extension is implemented and core-tested. Optional signed Int32 tab_group_index metadata, configured by with_tab_group_index(Int32?), is separate from existing tab_index and tab_stop metadata. Unlike upstream tab_group(), setting it does not implicitly enable focusability, tab-stop membership or alter the handle index.

Each focusable node is ordered by the complete active group-index prefix, including a group configured on that same node, followed by its own tab_index. Full paths compare lexicographically with stable tree-preorder ties; signed negatives are ordinary ordering values. Non-stop nodes remain anchors, and traversal skips them as destinations and wraps globally without a group focus trap.

Group metadata survives immutable builders, layout/prepaint and scroll translation; existing owner/acquisition, immutable snapshot, modality and route-only/keymap contracts remain unchanged. This slice does not introduce automatic Tab/Shift-Tab dispatch, new keymaps or broad retained-tree reconciliation.
